purpose: Technical experiment register; cohorts are not pooled into an investor headline.
cost_basis: Usage-derived recorded provider receipts under historical study rates, not invoice reconciliation or subscription charges.

cohorts.name: Latest fixed three-task candidate
cohorts.qualification: Two development replications and one held-out task; original Outbox review flags retained with bounded manual dispositions. No general quality or statistical significance claim.

cohorts.name: Earlier fixed focus candidate
cohorts.qualification: 10.1771% lower episode cost, 7.2954% lower first-submission cost; recorded quality lower. Codex Evidence Workbench includes two interrupted repair requests. Not a quality-preserving savings headline.

cohorts.name: Foundry original first deliveries
cohorts.qualification: One stochastic application build per implementation. Lower first cost accompanied lower recorded code score. Original failed evaluations and repair charges preserved.

cohorts.name: Foundry readiness first delivery
cohorts.qualification: First submission effective cost parity: 0.2476% lower. Codex control reused, not another independent task pair. Readiness and unused tool-definition changes confound causal attribution. Full interrupted episode retained.

cohorts.name: Foundry native patch trial
cohorts.qualification: No saving established; first submission has a real API defect. Opt-in trial, not promoted as default. Reused control and different screenshot coverage; no broad format conclusion.

cohorts.name: Heavy nested-team Foundry attempt
cohorts.qualification: Codex interrupted with unmatched admitted request and six of seven native identities created. No matched cost/quality victory can be inferred. Excluded from investor comparison headline.

non_inference_evidence.name: Logical accounting scale
non_inference_evidence.qualification: Component accounting workload; no billion-token inference quality or throughput claim.

non_inference_evidence.name: Latest V2 control suite
non_inference_evidence.qualification: Later V2 controls; historical paid CLI results use the legacy runner.

claim_controls: Do not pool reused controls, adaptive candidates, offline replays or different reviewers into a larger sample.
Do not equate a recorded static score with universal quality parity, security certification or production readiness.
Do not describe cost estimates and after-step controls as a guaranteed hard invoice cap.
Do not infer scientific research or production multiagent throughput from these coding-workflow results.
Do not claim that current local regression fixes caused historical paid savings.
